title: Breaking Conventions with The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild
summary: A 2017 GDC session in which Nintendo's Breath of the Wild team walks through how the game's convention-breaking systems were built. It covers the 'chemistry engine' of material interactions and shows the early 2D prototype footage.
why: HN commenters link it as the primary source for the 'multiplicative gameplay' idea and the chemistry engine behind BotW.

quote.text: broke down the creation of the game in a full length session with video of the original top-down 2D prototype
